plan.notes: Official curriculum guide published on the UW-Green Bay catalog's Nursing Curriculum Guides page (Prelicensure Nursing). The catalog explicitly labels these guides as examples ('An example: Four year plan... Plan is a representation and categories of classes can be switched. Check with your advisor.'); recorded with that caveat. The current page renders five 3-credit gen-ed/support slots without course names; their category labels (SOC SCI, HUM, ETS or GC, FA) are taken from the archived 2024-2025 edition of the same guide series and recorded as generic choice slots at 3 credits. Catalog edition year is not printed on the current page; recorded as 2025-2026, current edition as accessed 2026-10-10. Semester totals 16/18/17/17/17/16/15/15 = 131, matching the published Total Credits 131 (the degree requires 120 to graduate; the example plan sums to 131). BIOLOGY 201/202 and CHEM 108/109 are each published as a lecture-plus-lab pair totaling 4 credits; recorded as single 4-credit course entries (the catalog gives only the combined credit value).
